title: 第14章 一剑断山脉第15章 当小弟
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“看我茅山道法。”
看到白蛇这么厉害，无奈之下胡大为直接用手从身上掏出来一把金豆子，朝着地上一丢。
嘭的一声，金豆子在地上爆炸起来，化为了五个穿着金色盔甲，手持长刀的士兵，此乃茅山一脉有名的法术：撒豆成兵。
这五个金甲士兵快速的冲到了白蛇的面前，手中的长刀都劈砍在了白蛇的强大躯体上，火花四溅，竟然砍下了不少白色鳞片。
不过白蛇如此被攻击，自然也还手了，白蛇巨大的嘴巴朝下面咬死来，直接将一个金色士兵吞了下去。然后它巨大的尾巴一扫。
砰砰砰砰！
它直接将其余的四个金甲士兵打飞出去了。
金甲士兵落在地上后化为了道道精光消失掉了，化为了乌有，
自然撒都成兵变成了士兵也不是无敌的，都是有血量的，血量掉光了自然会消失。
白蛇力气庞大，一尾巴扫出几吨的力量，直接就秒杀了他们。
“怎么可能？”
看到自己的最厉害的法术都被白蛇破了，胡大为惊呆了，而看着朝着自己逼近的白蛇，胡大为无奈只好拼了。
他反手抽出了背上的木剑，随后咬破手指将鲜血抹在木剑的剑身上，霎那间木剑威力大增，发出了嗡嗡声响，红光耀眼。
胡大为这一招和电影《僵尸先生》里面的道士有点像，而道长一般都是这么对付僵尸的，这也没错。道长本身的鲜血就有降妖除魔的能力，如果将鲜血抹在武器上的确能增强武器威力。
而白蛇是千年蛇精，自然也是妖魔一脉。
胡大为手持沾染了鲜血的木剑直接冲到了白蛇面前，沾染了胡道长鲜血飞木剑瞬间化为了锋利的宝刃，直接就刺入了白蛇的躯体里，白蛇躯体流出来了白蛇的鲜血。
不过同样，白蛇在受伤后尾巴一扫直接打在了胡大为的身体上，白蛇的力气有多大直接把胡大为打的飞了出去。
砰！
胡大为身体直接撞击在了附近一块巨大无比岩石上，将岩石都打碎了。而胡大为本人更是全身骨头全断，脑浆迸裂，死的不能在死了。
胡大为是道长，是茅山派掌门，不过他终究是血肉之躯，哪里受得了如此骇人的力量，死是必然的。

而白蛇也不过是受了一点小伤而已，它身体伤口被木剑刺伤流出了一点鲜血，不过白蛇恢复能力很强，不过瞬间功夫伤口就不再流血了。
“没想到这个小道士有两把刷子，竟然能伤到的老夫白蛇，他能死在白蛇口下也算是三生有幸了。李少爷，现在老夫看看谁来拯救你。“
坐在白蛇头顶的欧阳锋则看着李聪聪冷笑起来，现在李聪聪的雇佣兵，胡大为全部都挂了，他知道李聪聪完蛋了。
至于李聪聪身边的陈锋，他直接无视了。
毕竟陈锋看起来太年轻了，压根不像很厉害的样子，而且陈锋一动不动，他以为陈锋吓傻了。
“完了全完了。”
看到自己最厉害的胡大师也挂了，李聪聪直接跪在了地上，他吓的瘫软了起来。
而看着距离他越来越近的白蛇，李聪聪闭上了眼睛，他知道自己的生命在今天就终结了。
李聪聪很不甘心，他这么帅这么有钱，家里还有那么多漂亮性感的女朋友他都没来得及享受。他还没有结婚也没子女，但是今天他就这么死了，还死的这么惨，真的不甘心啊。
他似乎听到了白蛇蠕动的声音，也闻到了刺鼻的腥臭味道，他知道那是白蛇嘴里的臭味。
“接下来白蛇应该张大嘴巴把我吞掉了吧。”
李聪聪心想，心里一阵绝望，因为李聪聪吓的双腿发软他没办法逃跑了，只等等死。
不过就在此刻，李聪聪忽然听到了一声响，好像是什么东西被打飞声音。
砰！
咔嚓！
李聪聪猛地睁开了眼睛，却发现白蛇和欧阳锋不见了。不对，他们不是不见了，而是出现在了20米外的地方。
content_en:
"Look at my Maoshan Taoist teachings."
Seeing how powerful White Snake was, Hu Dawei had no choice but to take out a handful of golden beans from his body and throw them towards the ground.
With a bang, the golden beans exploded on the ground and turned into five soldiers wearing golden armor and holding long knives. This is a famous magic in Maoshan: scattering beans and forming soldiers.
The five golden-armored soldiers quickly rushed in front of the white snake. The long knives in their hands slashed at the white snake's powerful body. Sparks flew everywhere and cut off many white scales.
However, the white snake was so attacked that it naturally fought back. The white snake's huge mouth bit downwards and swallowed a golden soldier directly. Then its huge tail swept.
Bang bang bang bang!
It directly knocked away the remaining four golden-armored soldiers.
After the golden-armored soldiers fell to the ground, they turned into streaks of light and disappeared, turning into nothing.
Naturally, Sado's soldiers are not invincible. They all have health. If they lose all their health, they will naturally disappear.
The White Snake was so powerful that it swept out several tons of power with one tail and killed them instantly.
"How is that possible?"
Seeing that his most powerful spell was broken by the white snake, Hu Dawei was shocked. Looking at the white snake approaching him, Hu Dawei had no choice but to fight.
He pulled out the wooden sword on his back with his backhand, then bit his finger and smeared the blood on the body of the wooden sword. In an instant, the power of the wooden sword increased greatly, and it made a buzzing sound and a dazzling red light.
Hu Dawei's move is a bit similar to the Taoist priest in the movie "Mr. Zombie", and Taoist priests usually deal with zombies this way, which is correct. The Taoist's own blood has the ability to subdue demons and eliminate demons. If the blood is applied to a weapon, it can indeed enhance the power of the weapon.
And White Snake is a thousand-year-old snake spirit, so naturally she is also of the demonic lineage.
Hu Dawei rushed directly in front of the white snake with a wooden sword stained with blood. The flying wooden sword stained with Daochang Hu's blood instantly turned into a sharp blade and pierced directly into the white snake's body. The white snake's blood flowed out of the white snake's body.
But again, after the white snake was injured, it swiped its tail and hit Hu Dawei directly on the body. The strength of the white snake was so strong that it sent Hu Dawei flying away.
Bang!
Hu Dawei's body directly hit a huge rock nearby, shattering the rock. Hu Dawei himself suffered all the bones in his body being broken, his brain was burst, and he could not die anymore.
Hu Dawei is a Taoist priest and the head of the Maoshan sect, but he is still made of flesh and blood. If he can withstand such terrifying power, death is inevitable.
The white snake only suffered a small injury. It was stabbed by the wooden sword and shed a little blood. However, the white snake has a strong recovery ability, but the wound stopped bleeding in an instant.
"I didn't expect that this little Taoist priest with two brushes could actually hurt old man Bai She. He can be considered lucky to die at Bai She's mouth. Master Li, now let me see who will save you."
Ouyang Feng, who was sitting on top of White Snake, looked at Li Congcong and sneered. Now that all of Li Congcong's mercenaries, Hu Dawei, were dead, he knew that Li Congcong was finished.
As for Chen Feng next to Li Congcong, he simply ignored him.
After all, Chen Feng looked too young and didn't look very powerful at all. Moreover, Chen Feng was motionless, so he thought Chen Feng was scared out of his wits.
"It's over, it's over."
Seeing that his most powerful Master Hu had also died, Li Congcong knelt on the ground, paralyzed with fear.
Looking at the white snake getting closer and closer to him, Li Congcong closed his eyes, knowing that his life would end today.
Li Congcong was very unwilling. He was so handsome and rich, and he had so many beautiful and sexy girlfriends at home that he didn't have time to enjoy. He was not married and had no children, but he died like this today, and died so miserably. I am really not willing to accept it.
He seemed to hear the squirming sound of the white snake and smell the pungent smell.Said, he knew that was the bad smell in the white snake's mouth.
"Next, the white snake should open its mouth wide and swallow me."
Li Congcong thought to himself, feeling desperate, because Li Congcong's legs were so frightened that he couldn't escape and could only wait to die.
But at this moment, Li Congcong suddenly heard a noise, as if something was being blown away.
Bang!
Click!
Li Congcong suddenly opened his eyes, only to find that White Snake and Ouyang Feng were missing. No, they didn't disappear, but appeared 20 meters away.
